decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical CPU type detection macro.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
dos/msinit.asm and bios/sysinit1.asm include and invoke Get_CPU_Type.
The saved msinit.lst places the macro expansion at module offsets 03C5h–03E8h; prior review 090 locates the module at target file offset 31848.
All 36 bytes of that expansion match target MSDOS.SYS at file offset 802Dh.
limitations: The direct comparison covers the selected DOS initialization macro expansion, not every build configuration or complete core files. Final links remain unverified.
